fork.instructions: Should this design-system question be answered here, handed to a specialist skill, or stopped for Andres?

criteria.answer_here: The question is which colour, type size, icon, radius, spacing, motion value, lock, existing component, or drift from the system. This skill's sources can answer it.
criteria.route_to_skill: The work is building a new surface, a craft polish of something already built, or a specialist concern that is not reading an existing token (typography polish, layout craft, a11y, copy, motion craft). Asking which colour or token the system already uses is answer_here, not this.
criteria.needs_andres: Nothing binds the value, the asker wants to mint a hue outside PALETTE, or the work would resize a neighbouring surface (feature-ledger rule 16).

source.instructions: Which one file or ledger should be opened? D# rows outrank other sources only when the question names a Feature, Project, DESIGN_ file, or D# row. A colour, type, icon, or token question with no Feature name opens that token file. Do not pick a derived docs/design/*.md file when a token module exists. An existence question (does this component already exist) is components_ui.

criteria.feature_d_rows: The question names a Feature, a Project, a DESIGN_ file, or a D# row, and asks which system value that surface uses. Do not pick this when the asker only says this button or this chip and names no Feature.
criteria.colour_palette: The question is which colour, hue, palette, or status colour to use, and it names no Feature. Open tools/build-palette.mjs (PALETTE) and __tests__/palette.test.ts.
criteria.type_ramp: Type ramp, fonts, weights. Open app/globals.css @theme --text-* and __tests__/theme-tokens.test.ts.
criteria.buttons: Buttons, ledges, variants. Open thovenButtonTokens in lib/live-lesson-tokens.ts and components/ui/thoven-button.tsx.
criteria.icons: Icons and the two tiers. Open lib/icon-tokens.ts and the icon tests.
criteria.motion: Motion, springs, reduced motion. Open lib/motion-config.ts.
criteria.layout: Layout, viewport, spacing. There is no token module. Open docs/design/layout.md.
criteria.lexicon: What a thing is called. Open design-system/lexicon/LEXICON.md in thoven2.0.
criteria.components_ui: Does a component already exist? Dialog, sheet, popover, primitive. Open components/ui/ (primitives only). Pick this over feature_d_rows when no Feature is named.
criteria.stack_md: Could a user name it, build or take, Interior vs base-ui. Open design-system/STACK.md rule 7.
criteria.design_md: A declared lock, a divergence row, or intent with no token module. Open DESIGN.md.
